subject.title: feature: system event priority/bypass-queue mode for reliable in-session alerts

question: Should OpenClaw add an urgent system-alert contract here, and should it be operator-visible only, prompt-visible session injection, or both?
rationale: The remaining choice changes trusted system-event ordering and user-visible incident behavior, so automation cannot safely choose the contract from source inspection alone.

options.title: Split UI alert from prompt injection
options.body: Add an immediate operator-visible alert path and keep prompt-visible transcript mutation behind a separate explicit trusted event contract.

options.title: Add prompt-visible priority injection
options.body: Allow high-priority system events to bypass busy lanes, but require typed auth, sanitization, ordering, and replay tests before merge.

options.title: Keep best-effort wake semantics
options.body: Decline queue bypass and document that external transports remain the real-time alert path during provider incidents.

recommendation.title: Split UI alert from prompt injection
recommendation.body: Add an immediate operator-visible alert path and keep prompt-visible transcript mutation behind a separate explicit trusted event contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest existing shipped expansion is the typed wake/sessionKey protocol and system-event CLI work.
